notes: Forwarded chain: agent forwards a listing team's reduction notice to their buyer list. Prior price only in the quoted portion. Tests reduction cue inside a '>' quoted forward.

input.subject: FW: Price adjustment - 200 W 24th St PH2, Chelsea
input.bodyText:
Passing this along for anyone with a Chelsea buyer - just came down $400k, seller wants it done.

Nina

-----Original Message-----
From: Listings Team <team@westsidegroup.com>
Sent: Saturday, August 1, 2026 9:12 AM
To: Broker Network
Subject: Price adjustment - 200 W 24th St PH2

> We've adjusted pricing on the penthouse exclusive:
> 200 W 24th St, PH2, Chelsea
> 3BR / 3.5BA + private roof cabana
> Previously asking $6,200,000, now offered at $5,800,000
> Co-broke 2.5%. Board approval required.
> Reach out to schedule.
